subject.title: Draft: add read-only CLI catalog and operator views

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this CLI catalog and the new plugin descriptor metadata as a supported operator and automation contract?
rationale: The open RFC and draft PR intentionally introduce permanent core CLI and plugin API surface; code review cannot choose that ownership and stability commitment without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve and harden
options.body: Accept the core catalog direction, then require explicit incomplete-inventory diagnostics, public plugin contract documentation, real CLI proof, and refreshed-base validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the primitive
options.body: Keep only a smaller read-only inventory seam and defer audit, summary, test-plan, and plugin effect metadata until concrete consumers are proven.

options.title: Decline the core contract
options.body: Pause or close the implementation and continue catalog experiments outside OpenClaw's supported core and plugin API surface.

recommendation.title: Approve and harden
recommendation.body: Accept the core catalog direction, then require explicit incomplete-inventory diagnostics, public plugin contract documentation, real CLI proof, and refreshed-base validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current CLI descriptor and plugin descriptor contracts and has the strongest product-history signal for accepting or narrowing this new surface.
